tokens.name: bl-amber
tokens.usage: Steel blue. Primary frame slot: elbows, header bands, `mono-ink`. As text on `bl-space` (wide sub-lines) it is about 3.8:1 in the default theme: use it only at 24px and up. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-tan
tokens.usage: Sea-glass teal. Secondary frame fill and default text (`bl-text`) on `bl-space`. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-lilac
tokens.usage: Deep navy. Third frame colour; dark fill that takes `bl-on-lilac` text. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-peach
tokens.usage: Lagoon. Wide headline text and readouts on `bl-space`; muted text in the default theme. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-violet
tokens.usage: Blue. Headline sub-lines and readout columns on `bl-space`. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-sky
tokens.usage: Cyan. Tiny highlights only; `bl-frame-accent` and `bl-nominal`. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-sunflower
tokens.usage: Gold. Title sub-lines on `bl-space` (text only, never blocks); `bl-caution`. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-orchid
tokens.usage: Orange. Title text on `bl-space` via `bl-title`; never a block. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-rust
tokens.usage: Deep. Dark fill that takes `bl-on-rust` text. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-ice
tokens.usage: Ghost grey. Pale frame accent. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-rose
tokens.usage: Light red. Secondary alert colour; alert only. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-red
tokens.usage: Orange-red. Alert only (`bl-alert`); also the selected-button inset ring. Slot names are legacy role names kept for API stability; each theme remaps the slot.

tokens.name: bl-on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on `bl-amber` fills. Default theme: black on steel blue is about 3.8:1, under 4.5:1 for small text; kept as the source defines it. Use 24px+ labels on amber, or prefer lighter fills for small labels.

tokens.name: bl-on-lilac
tokens.usage: Text on `bl-lilac` fills (light blue on navy in the default theme).

tokens.name: bl-on-rust
tokens.usage: Text on `bl-rust` fills. Classic theme: black on #CC6633 is about 4.9:1.

tokens.name: bl-title
tokens.usage: Title text on `bl-space`. Headlines are orange text, never orange blocks.
